tools.name: search_robot_catalog
tools.description: Search Valumech's read-only robot catalog by words, category, market status, or a maximum approximate USD price. At least one filter is required.

tools.name: get_robot_price
tools.description: Return Valumech's sourced new-price record, configurations, evidence date, availability, modeled used-value summary, and canonical page for one robot.

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Compare two Valumech robots using sourced prices and specifications plus clearly labeled modeled depreciation. Returns a canonical or interactive comparison URL.

tools.name: estimate_used_value
tools.description: Calculate Valumech's illustrative used-value range for a delivered, publicly priced robot. This is a modeled placeholder, not an appraisal or resale comp.

tools.name: get_purchase_options
tools.description: Return dated official and affiliate buying links recorded by Valumech for one robot. This never opens a retailer, submits data, adds to cart, or purchases.
